tasks.short: Diagnose, treat, or provide continuous care to hospital inpatients

steps.what: Read the ward record before seeing this hospital inpatient
Examine this hospital inpatient at the bedside
Decide the working diagnosis and the inpatient treatment plan
Write only the accepted inpatient care plan into the clinical record

tasks.design: She examines the inpatient and decides the diagnosis and the plan. A write in the clinical record {OTHER} files only the plan she accepted, and it does not choose the diagnosis. A rejection files nothing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The diagnosis and the record entry were one pass, so filing the plan was not split from deciding it.
tasks.enabler_now: The plan fields are a fixed list she fills. Copying an accepted plan into the record needs no model.
tasks.still_hard: The examination and the diagnosis stay hers. A plan she has not accepted is not filed.
tasks.human_edge: She decides the diagnosis and the plan for this inpatient.
tasks.altitude: Filing the accepted plan leaves her week. She still examines the inpatient and decides the diagnosis.

reach.task: Give the treatments named in the accepted care plan
reach.learn: Which bedside treatments she named, and that the nurse does not change the diagnosis

evidence.claim: Filing a diagnosis and a plan she already accepted does not make the diagnosis. This is model knowledge.
Solely automated care decisions need an art. 22(2) basis.
A human decision followed by a write of the plan she accepted is not a decision made solely by software. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: She examines, decides and files the care plan today, so every step keeps her as the actor. The machine is only the future of that filing.
Structured fields she states before the write: working diagnosis (her words) and plan lines (her words). A blank plan files nothing.
The write copies only the accepted plan. It does not draft a diagnosis and it does not wait on a draft of its own.
The clinical record stays inside the organisation. Nothing is sent to an external model. A change to the plan voids the acceptance.
Upkeep hours are zero. A plan she rejects is not rewritten by the tool.
unknowns: Which extra plan fields this ward requires beyond the diagnosis and the plan lines.
research_questions: Which care-plan fields are mandatory on this ward beyond the diagnosis and the plan lines?

already_counted.description: The diagnosis and the plan, already in the decision before the record write.

incremental.description: A rejected plan is not filed. There is no later rewrite queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: days when the plan fields do not match the ward form, so she often types the record herself. High: days when the diagnosis and the plan lines match the form, so the write runs, while the examination and the decision stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prescribe medications or treatment regimens to hospital inpatients

steps.what: Read allergies and medicines already given to this inpatient
Name the candidate inpatient drug, dose and route
List formulary conflicts for that named inpatient drug
Select the medication this hospital inpatient should receive
Prescribe that selected medication in the inpatient record
Tell this inpatient what the prescribed medication is for

tasks.design: She names the drug, the dose and the route. A formulary check in the clinical record {OTHER} lists conflicts for that drug and does not prescribe. She selects the medicine, writes the prescription herself, and tells the patient. A blank name runs no list.
tasks.previous_blocker: Looking up interactions and choosing the drug were one pass at the order screen.
tasks.enabler_now: A formulary already checks interactions, contraindications, doses and duplicates for a drug she named.
tasks.still_hard: She still chooses the drug and writes the prescription. The list does not prescribe.
tasks.human_edge: She judges whether a conflict still allows this drug for this inpatient.
tasks.altitude: The conflict list leaves her week. She still selects the drug, writes the prescription and tells the patient.

reach.task: Check the named drug against the formulary
reach.learn: Which drug she named, and that a conflict hit does not change the prescription

evidence.claim: The G-Standaard checks interactions, contraindications, doses and duplicates.
A conflict list for a drug she named does not choose the drug. This is model knowledge.
A prescription comes from a named practitioner under Wet BIG art. 36(14).

assumptions: She selects and prescribes today, so those steps keep her as the actor. The machine appears only as the future conflict list.
Structured fields she names before the list: drug, dose and route. A blank name runs no list.
The list does not wait and it does not write a prescription. She writes the prescription herself.
The formulary is an existing organisational list. Its runtime is not her effort. The clinical record stays inside the organisation.
Upkeep hours are zero. She handles a conflict in the selection, and there is no later queue.
unknowns: Whether the order screen already shows formulary hits for the drug she named.
research_questions: Does this order screen already show formulary hits for a named drug, dose and route?

already_counted.description: Judging each conflict hit, already in the selection before she prescribes.

incremental.description: A conflict is judged in the selection. There is no later queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: hours when she already knows the interactions and rarely waits on a list. High: hours when the named drug has several hits she would otherwise look up, while choosing and prescribing stay hers.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Order or interpret laboratory tests and radiographs

steps.what: Read which clinical question this admission still needs answered
Name the laboratory test or radiograph to order
Decide that this laboratory test or radiograph should be ordered
Place only the accepted test order in the inpatient record
Read the laboratory result and the radiograph report
Interpret what these test results mean for this inpatient

tasks.design: She names the test and decides it should be ordered. A write in the clinical record {OTHER} places only that accepted order. She still reads the result and the report and interprets them. A rejection places nothing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Choosing the test and typing the order were one pass, so the order entry was not split from the decision.
tasks.enabler_now: The order is a named test plus the question it answers. Copying an accepted order into the record needs no model.
tasks.still_hard: She still decides which test to order, and she still interprets the result. The write does not read an image.
tasks.human_edge: She decides which test this admission needs, and what the result means for this inpatient.
tasks.altitude: Placing the accepted order leaves her week. She still chooses the test and interprets the result.

reach.learn: Which view she ordered, and that the technologist does not interpret the result for the admission

evidence.claim: Placing a test order she accepted does not interpret the laboratory result or the radiograph. This is model knowledge.
Writing an order she accepted is not a reading of the image. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: She orders tests today, so the order write keeps her as the actor. The machine is only the future of that filing. Reading and interpreting stay hers with no machine step.
Structured fields she names before the write: the test and the question it answers. A blank test places no order.
The laboratory result and the radiograph report arrive from the lab and from radiology. They are not produced by the order write.
The clinical record stays inside the organisation. A change to the named test voids the acceptance. A rejection places nothing.
Upkeep hours are zero. An order she rejects is not retyped by the tool.
unknowns: Whether the order screen already files a named test once she confirms it.
research_questions: Does this order screen already file a named test after she confirms it?

already_counted.description: Deciding the test is the right one, already in the review before the order is placed.

incremental.description: A rejected order is not placed. There is no later queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: days when the test name does not match the order catalogue, so she types the order herself. High: days when the named test matches, so the write runs, while choosing the test and interpreting the result stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: See the patient and hear why a hospital stay is being asked
State the reason, the ward and the expected length of stay
Decide whether to admit this patient for a hospital stay
Write only the accepted admission into the clinical record

tasks.design: She sees the patient, states the reason, the ward and the expected stay, and decides whether to admit. A write in the clinical record {OTHER} files only the admission she accepted. A rejection files nothing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The admission decision and the record entry were one pass, so filing was not split from deciding.
tasks.enabler_now: The admission fields are a fixed list she fills. Copying an accepted admission into the record needs no model.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing the patient and deciding to admit stay hers. A decision she has not accepted is not filed.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether this patient should be admitted.
tasks.altitude: Filing the accepted admission leaves her week. She still sees the patient and decides whether to admit.

reach.task: Prepare the ward bed after the admission is accepted
reach.learn: Which ward she named, and that the nurse does not decide the admission

evidence.claim: Filing an admission she already accepted does not decide whether the patient should be admitted. This is model knowledge.
Solely automated care decisions need an art. 22(2) basis.
A human decision followed by a write of the admission she accepted is not a decision made solely by software. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: She decides and files the admission today, so every step keeps her as the actor. The machine is only the future of that filing.
Structured fields she states before the write: reason (one sentence), ward (a name) and expected stay (a number of days). A blank reason files nothing.
The write copies only the accepted admission. It does not decide fitness to admit and it does not wait on a draft of its own.
Talking with the referring clinician stays in the room. The clinical record stays inside the organisation. A change to the fields voids the acceptance.
Upkeep hours are zero. An admission she rejects is not rewritten by the tool.
unknowns: Which extra admission fields this hospital requires beyond reason, ward and expected stay.
research_questions: Which admission fields are mandatory here beyond reason, ward and expected stay?

already_counted.description: Deciding whether to admit, already in the review before the record write.

incremental.description: A rejected admission is not filed. There is no later rewrite queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: days when the admission fields do not match the hospital form, so she often types the record herself. High: days when reason, ward and expected stay match, so the write runs, while seeing the patient and the decision stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The examination, the prescription, the test interpretation and the admission decision stay in her week. Only the accepted care-plan write, the conflict list, the accepted order write and the accepted admission write leave it. She gains no new decision right.
skills_to_grow: State the diagnosis and the plan before the record write, and still make the diagnosis herself.
Treat a formulary hit as a warning. She still chooses the drug and writes the prescription.
Name the test before the order is filed, and still interpret the result herself.
role.ambitious_version: The week does not grow. She does not take more inpatients because a plan, an order or an admission can be filed.
